sourceStatement: Recorded ensemble member file, hand-authored for demonstration and replay. It is NOT obtained from Copernicus GloFAS or any other ensemble product: BEACON has no wired live ensemble source (finding F-34) and queries no ensemble product at runtime. The 51-member count mirrors the ensemble size the anticipatory-action literature describes; the discharge values are invented. Run 2: the later, converged spread at a 40 h horizon.
